caption: The drawing features a rectangular design with rounded corners, set against a plain, off-white background. The main composition is a large, yellow rectangle bordered by a decorative white pattern along the edge. Inside this yellow panel, there are two concentric oval loops: the outer oval is decorated with green leaves, each leaf separated by small pink flower motifs intertwined with curling pink stems. The inner oval contains a decorative central motif, with a green, elongated oval shape surrounded by alternating white and pink petal-like shapes. Between the two ovals, there are white ornamental flourishes and numerous evenly spaced green dots that fill the yellow space. The overall layout is symmetrical, and the drawing is rendered using primarily yellow, green, pink, and white colors.
title: Bandbox - Castle Garden
